runtime_prompt_en: A photographic music-making scene in a quiet home studio at first blue dawn. The person guided by the supplied reference portrait is actively creating music, testing the final held chord of a synth loop while listening closely to its changing tone. Her visible facial features follow the supplied portrait, with its short dark bob with fine parted fringe. Her face is fully visible above the equipment; a slight absorbed smile and relaxed open overshirt give the concentrated moment a quiet, intimate appeal. She sits behind one compact synthesizer at a shallow rectangular desk, facing the camera. The entire desk perimeter and all equipment sit comfortably inside a wide landscape frame, with a clear band of tabletop beyond every cable bend. Her shoulders, elbows and wrists form two separate uncrossed arm chains. Her anatomical LEFT arm is on the RIGHT side of the photograph: that left index and middle finger press two adjacent white keys down. Her anatomical RIGHT arm is on the LEFT side of the photograph: that right thumb and index finger pinch and rotate one raised cutoff knob in the synthesizer's right-hand control bank. The keys and knob contact surfaces are seen from above; other fingers curve freely beside their targets. The synthesizer has its keyboard nearest the performer and its right control bank at image left, within easy reach of her right elbow. One audio interface sits in the open front-left corner of the desk and one laptop sits in the open front-right corner, its screen opened to about 165 degrees so the display lies nearly face-up, sloping gently toward the performer; both the musician above it and the elevated camera see the same display surface. One nearfield speaker stands behind the laptop. A single black audio cable runs from a visible output jack on the synthesizer's camera-facing edge across exposed tabletop to a visible input jack on the audio interface; both inserted plugs and the full uninterrupted black route are visible. A separate blue USB cable runs from a visible USB socket on the audio interface in a broad shallow curve across the front center of the desk to a visible USB socket on the laptop's left edge; both inserted plugs and the full uninterrupted blue route are visible. The black and blue routes are spatially separate and fully contained inside the tabletop. On the laptop, a plausible multitrack DAW arrangement shows a short repeated synth waveform region, two supporting waveform lanes and its active track meter, visually belonging to this connected instrument setup. The speaker, laptop, interface and synthesizer each have their own clear outline. Photograph from a centered frontal viewpoint looking down at the tabletop at about 65 degrees, using a moderately wide natural perspective. Her chin lifts slightly within the relaxed seated pose, keeping the face open to this high camera. The nearly face-up laptop display, both hands, the synth output, interface input and USB socket, and laptop USB socket all lie inside this common downward viewing cone. Keep her face, the two distinct hand contacts, every cable segment and all four cable endpoints simultaneously sharp and large enough to inspect. Cool dawn light from the side window meets a low warm task light across her hands and the desk, preserving clean separation between dark cables, ports and pale wood. A broad soft bounce of the existing window daylight from the pale wall behind the camera gently fills her facial planes while the desk retains the side-window direction. The feeling is a private breakthrough heard before the rest of the home wakes.

references.role: Reference image for the primary person visible face and short dark bob with fine parted fringe only. No identity, age, biography, clothing or composition inference.
